title: MOOR Software Manufacturing System — Physical Discipline, Software Throughput
page0: Turn the MOOR software machine into a fake 3D machine whose visible geometry makes the production process intuitive, while the underlying logic is fully real, deterministic, maintainable and auditable. Bring the practical benefits of physical manufacturing into software manufacturing and make that production capability as accessible as possible.
correctedQuestion: What is the smallest real manufacturing system MOOR can enforce underneath an intuitive 3D factory metaphor so ordinary requests become reproducible software work orders with standard parts, deterministic operations, quality gates, traceability, rework, maintenance and continuous improvement?
principle: The 3D machine is a digital twin/HMI. Contracts, state transitions, evidence and receipts are the machine.
manufacturingBenefits: standard work instead of rediscovered process
interchangeable versioned parts instead of copied logic
bill-of-materials visibility instead of hidden dependencies
routing and work-in-progress visibility instead of opaque agent loops
poka-yoke / fail-closed contracts instead of silent semantic degradation
inspection and tolerances instead of binary 'it exists' checks
travelers and lot traceability instead of undocumented provenance
nonconformance and rework routing instead of repeated retries
configuration control instead of stale rebuild clobber
preventive maintenance instead of discovering broken infrastructure during a build
process capability learning instead of relearning failures
line balancing/resource budgets instead of uncontrolled parallel complexity

existingStations.name: OBJECTIVE
existingStations.rule: Do not name the machine before the external objective is understood.

existingStations.name: HUB
existingStations.rule: Define once; instantiate by identity + parameters; incompatible contexts refuse loudly.

existingStations.name: Funnel / Ultra Funnel
existingStations.manufacturingRole: process planning, routing, decision gates and authority
existingStations.rule: Page 0 remains immutable; work cannot skip required gates.

existingStations.name: MOOR Assembly Core
existingStations.manufacturingRole: digital work instructions / deterministic operation sequence
existingStations.rule: A valid AssemblyContract enumerates inputs, dependencies, operations, executors, outputs, verification and rollback.

existingStations.name: Harness / builders
existingStations.rule: Execution receives authorized work, not unbounded intent.

existingStations.name: Verifier / CI
existingStations.rule: Presence is not proof; inspect the requested path and tolerances.

existingStations.name: MOOR Refinery / Capability Memory
existingStations.manufacturingRole: tool crib, process capability library and reusable verified operations
existingStations.rule: Reuse verified capability with provenance instead of recreating it.

existingStations.name: Pulse learning / failures
existingStations.manufacturingRole: nonconformance history, CAPA and continuous improvement
existingStations.rule: A repeated defect changes the process, not merely the next attempt.

existingStations.name: Pulse Beam 3D
existingStations.manufacturingRole: factory HMI / digital twin / line observability
existingStations.rule: Visual state reflects authoritative production state; geometry never creates authority.

qualityLaw: Verified is not released unless the correct configuration/BOM was tested.
Every critical characteristic has an explicit measurement method and tolerance.
Every nonconformance has a disposition: rework, use-as-is with explicit approval, scrap/rollback, or block.
Rework loops are bounded; repeated defects create a process-maintenance issue.
A stale build source or missing manifest dependency is a configuration-control nonconformance.
accessibilityLaw: Natural language is the customer-facing work-order form; users should not need manufacturing vocabulary.
The system derives records automatically and only exposes complexity when useful.
3D spatial representation should answer: where is my work, what station is it in, why is it waiting, what failed, and what can I do?
Every spatial control has a non-3D/text alternative.
A user can inspect provenance and evidence without understanding internal implementation details.
Common work uses standardized routes; novel work can generate a new route through the Funnel.

maintenance.goal: Treat the software factory itself as production equipment.
requirements: Every station has machine-readable health: documented / implemented / wired / verified / receipt-backed / visualized.
CI reports station-specific failures rather than one opaque red pipeline.
Build generators carry protected platform BOM entries forward.
A changed production route or KIND creates a new version instead of silently mutating prior authority.
Preventive checks run on the request router, Funnel authority, Beam shell wiring, manifest/BOM integrity and live bytes.
The 3D factory can render health and WIP from these records but cannot fabricate green state.

immediateBuild: Use funnel-maintenance-status.json as the initial equipment-health register.
Preserve Pulse Beam shell + manifest entries in the dashboard build generator.
Add CI checks that distinguish authority logic, shell wiring, BOM/manifest integrity and visualization.
Index this blueprint in Funnel Fabric.
Expose the manufacturing model to agents in AGENTS.md so future builders know the 3D layer is an HMI, not source of truth.
futureBuild: Create a first-class WorkOrder/Traveler runtime shared by v44/Ultra/Harness.
Render WIP and station health inside Pulse Beam as a factory line view.
Add NCR/rework records and bounded reinspection loops.
Add preventive-maintenance schedules for production-critical software assets.
Measure process capability: first-pass yield, rework rate, escaped defects, average queue time, station utilization and configuration-drift incidents.
doneCriteria: The manufacturing analogy maps to existing executable MOOR systems rather than duplicating them.
Pulse Beam is explicitly an HMI/digital twin, not an authority source.
The build generator cannot silently erase Beam shell/BOM integration.
Maintenance status distinguishes documented, implemented, wired, verified and receipt-backed states.
Agents can discover the model from the normal repository entry documentation.
The architecture remains usable without the 3D view.
